alpaca_basic_historical_sip_contract.free_sip_condition: The explicit request end must be at least fifteen minutes old.
alpaca_basic_historical_sip_contract.limit_scope: total data points per response page, not per symbol
alpaca_basic_historical_sip_contract.pagination_rule: Drain each unique non-empty next_page_token through null; a repeated token, missing terminal token field, or page beyond a frozen cap fails the chain.
alpaca_basic_historical_sip_contract.explicit_parameter_rule: Never rely on provider defaults. Freeze symbols, timeframe, start, end, feed, adjustment, sort, limit, and asof in every request identity.
alpaca_basic_historical_sip_contract.free_contract_failure_action: Stop Program 005. Do not buy Algo Trader Plus or select another provider under this plan.

licensing_and_retention_gate.api_use_documentation: Alpaca describes the Historical API as usable for charting, backtesting, and powering trading strategies.
licensing_and_retention_gate.customer_agreement: The current customer agreement incorporates Nasdaq and NYSE market-data agreements where applicable and says market data may not be reproduced, distributed, sold, or commercially exploited in any manner without Alpaca's written consent. Both incorporated agreements were accessible and reviewed before freeze; neither expressly grants the required immutable-copy rights.
licensing_and_retention_gate.required_resolution: Applicable terms or written Alpaca confirmation must expressly permit noncommercial personal research, private immutable raw response retention, private backups, canonical derived artifacts, and audit reproduction without a paid recurring plan.
licensing_and_retention_gate.hash_only_refetch_reason: Hashes can detect later provider corrections but cannot reconstruct the frozen bytes. Re-fetching a moving source therefore fails exact campaign reproducibility.
licensing_and_retention_gate.failure_action: Keep the prospective plan but do not load credentials, request data, or escalate to a paid plan.

preserved_economic_contract.early_close_context_rule: A complete scheduled early-close grid may supply 09:30-11:30 context but may not be evaluated because exact four-hour exits are unavailable.

canonical_data_architecture.primary_source: Alpaca Basic historical SIP stock bars

canonical_source_view.use: Immutable provider evidence, raw contemporaneous fill prices, marks, and P&L inputs.

analytical_source_view.use: Frozen analytical OHLCV for same-session return features, prior twenty-session relative volume, and prior median dollar-volume capacity.

canonical_data_architecture.paired_request_rule: Raw and analytical chains use identical method, endpoint, symbols, timeframe, start, end, feed, sort, limit, and asof; only adjustment differs. Both views are predeclared and neither may be queried reactively to repair a gap.
generic_provider_blockers: It defaults to IEX rather than SIP.
It requests adjustment=all rather than raw plus split,spin-off views.
It extends end by one interval under an obsolete exclusive-end assumption, while the current stock-bars reference documents inclusive end.
canonical_data_architecture.future_adapter_scope: A later separately authorized Program 005 adapter must implement this exact GET-only contract. No adapter is added by this plan.

corporate_action_policy.split_price_rule: Use the frozen split,spin-off analytical view for cross-session comparable features. Use raw contemporaneous prices for every fill, mark, and P&L calculation.
corporate_action_policy.split_volume_rule: Alpaca documents split adjustment of both price and volume. The analytical view must scale price and volume reciprocally and keep one constant factor within each symbol-session.
corporate_action_policy.relative_volume_rule: Split-normalized volume places the current morning and twenty prior mornings in one share unit. Raw volume may not cross a split boundary in this feature.
corporate_action_policy.equal_dollar_rule: Fractional equal-dollar sizing and bps-on-notional costs use raw fill prices. A constant analytical scale cannot change target notional, cost, or raw P&L.
corporate_action_policy.cash_dividend_rule: Do not adjust prices or add cash. Every return feature starts after the open and every position opens and closes in one session, so no position owns the overnight distribution entitlement.
corporate_action_policy.ordinary_dividend_session_action: Eligible when the complete grid and every other admission control pass.
corporate_action_policy.spin_off_rule: Use the predeclared split,spin-off analytical price view. If the action identity, effective date, factor, or within-session constancy is ambiguous, exclude the affected session from evaluation and context and count it against the total exclusion ceiling. An unresolved action ledger fails dataset admission.
corporate_action_policy.action_ledger_rule: Before dataset freeze, bind issuer or exchange evidence for every in-range split or spin-off and reconcile it to raw-versus-analytical factor changes. An unexplained factor change fails admission.
corporate_action_policy.correction_rule: A later provider correction or corporate-action change creates a new dataset version. It cannot overwrite frozen pages or reopen an exposed campaign.

missing_data_policy.minimum_cross_section: All twelve ranking ETFs plus SPY at every required regular-session five-minute bar open.
missing_data_policy.required_grid: Every bar needed for the causal lookback, 11:30 decision, selected execution delay, holding interval, exit, and prior twenty complete-session context.
missing_data_policy.incomplete_session_action: Exclude the whole session from every configuration, benchmark, and later context use.

known_quarantine.source_fact: Nine required MDY five-minute coordinates were already absent, and prior one-minute evidence also left the February targets absent.
known_quarantine.action: Exclude all five sessions unconditionally even if a later Alpaca response contains every coordinate. Do not use them as evaluation dates or future relative-volume context.
known_quarantine.reason: Fixed exclusion prevents a later provider correction from changing campaign membership and uses no strategy return. It is a quarantine, not a tolerance inferred from the missing count.

global_loss_limit.rule_origin: Exact source-neutral Program 003 missing-data ceiling, frozen and independently reviewed before Program 005 selected Alpaca.
global_loss_limit.independence_evidence: Program 003 selected Tiingo, not Alpaca, and its frozen derivation expressly recorded that the known five-session MDY pattern failed its block, rolling-quarter, and same-symbol controls. Program 005 therefore does not choose a new global number to admit Alpaca; it preserves the exact pre-existing total ceiling and separately justifies only the bounded fixed-date disposition.
global_loss_limit.scientific_scope: The seven-session ceiling is a prospective source-coverage control, not a power calculation, confidence interval, missing-completely-at-random claim, or substitute for concentration checks. The inherited program expressly makes no formal power claim and treats the session as only an upper-bound sampling unit because serial and cross-symbol dependence reduce effective observations.
global_loss_limit.derivation: Program 003 froze a one-percent and one-session ceiling within each 125-126-session evidence block, then imposed the stricter one-half-percent program-wide accumulation ceiling. floor(1499 * 0.005) = 7. That source-neutral rule and its finding-free review predate this successor and remain unchanged. Only afterward do the five exact design quarantines consume five slots and leave two unexpected slots.

known_quarantine_concentration_contract.retention_floor_derivation: Two times the inherited 60-active-session discovery gate. A block with at least 120 complete opportunities never requires more than a 50 percent activation rate solely because sessions were removed.
known_quarantine_concentration_contract.block_balance_rule: The fixed quarantine may not increase the original maximum difference in full-session opportunity across the three discovery blocks.
known_quarantine_concentration_contract.validation_rule: Every fixed quarantine must remain in discovery-only evidence; no walk-forward test, final exposed fold, controlled block, or initial context session may be quarantined under this class.

calendar_concentration_contract.monthly_floor_origin: The inherited final-exposed-fold and controlled-block gates each require at least fifteen active sessions. Requiring at least fifteen complete opportunities in every affected month is stricter than those gates require of a month and prevents the fixed quarantine from removing the ability to supply that pre-existing evidence floor.
calendar_concentration_contract.complete_year_floor_origin: Two times the independently anchored 120-session discovery-block retention floor.
calendar_concentration_contract.partial_year_rule: A boundary year that is not fully exposed must pass its fixed discovery-block retention and balance gates; it is not compared with a fabricated full-year denominator.
calendar_concentration_contract.decision_rule: Fail admission if an affected month or complete year falls below its retained-session floor or an affected partial year fails its governing fixed-block gates. Counts are machine gates, not reviewer-only reports.

clock_concentration_contract.reference_limit: The clock tail is an exact uniform-coordinate randomization reference, not evidence that provider omissions are random. It detects a repeated clock mechanism and supplements the exact strategy-clock cap.
clock_concentration_contract.decision_rule: Fail admission if any five-minute clock reaches three fixed missing coordinates or any exact decision, entry, or exit clock is missing on more than one fixed session. Reviewer override is prohibited.

known_quarantine_concentration_contract.bounded_membership: Only the five exact known quarantine dates. No later date may be added to this class.
known_quarantine_concentration_contract.global_budget_treatment: All five count against the inherited seven-session global ceiling.
known_quarantine_concentration_contract.acceptance_rule: All fixed membership, discovery-only, 120-session block retention, unchanged block-balance, nonadjacency, month, year, clock, global-budget, context, and SPY/MDY randomization-reference gates must pass. Failure of any part stops dataset admission without reviewer override.
known_quarantine_concentration_contract.reason: The fixed dates use no strategy return, remove no validation observation, leave 122, 122, and 125 complete discovery sessions, preserve the original three-session block-opportunity range, and never form an adjacent outage. Whole-session exclusion contains the known MDY-specific mechanism. The class creates no generalized block, month, year, rolling-window, clock, or same-symbol allowance for a later defect.

required_reports: excluded sessions and coordinates by symbol
excluded sessions by month and year
missing coordinates by five-minute bar-open time
SPY and MDY morning absolute-return, range, and volume quartiles computed without strategy returns

spy_and_mdy_morning_diagnostics.population: All 1,499 full trade-eligible sessions before source-missingness disposition, including an excluded session when each reference symbol's complete morning is available.
spy_and_mdy_morning_diagnostics.window: 09:30 through the 11:30 New York decision: open at 09:30 and bars opened 09:30 through 11:25.
metrics: per-symbol absolute return from the 09:30 open to the 11:25 bar close
per-symbol high-low range across bars opened 09:30 through 11:25 divided by the minimum low
per-symbol volume across bars opened 09:30 through 11:25
spy_and_mdy_morning_diagnostics.quartile_rule: For each metric, sort ascending by metric and then session date. Each tail contains ceil(population session count / 4) sessions. Test the highest absolute-return tail, highest range tail, and lowest volume tail.
spy_and_mdy_morning_diagnostics.reference_null: uniform selection of exclusion dates without replacement from the deterministic 1,499-session population
spy_and_mdy_morning_diagnostics.interpretation_limit: These are exact randomization-reference probabilities under the uniform-date null. The fixed exclusions were not randomly sampled, so this gate neither proves missing-completely-at-random behavior nor independently admits the quarantine. It supplements the deterministic discovery-only, retention, balance, nonadjacency, and no-expansion gates.
spy_and_mdy_morning_diagnostics.unavailable_rule: A missing SPY or MDY bar needed for any diagnostic makes the diagnostic unavailable and fails dataset admission.
spy_and_mdy_morning_diagnostics.decision_rule: Reject dataset admission if any tested tail reaches its frozen rejection count. Reviewer discretion cannot override, waive, or reinterpret this result.

bias_audit.failure_action: Any global coverage, fixed-quarantine block, month, year, clock, unexpected fixed-block, unexpected rolling, total consecutive, unexpected same-symbol, adjacency, context, corporate-action, or SPY/MDY randomization-reference failure stops dataset admission before strategy execution.

missing_data_policy.known_mdy_comparison_after_derivation: The independently pre-existing global ceiling permits seven total sessions. The five fixed quarantine sessions consume five slots and leave two isolated unexpected slots. Their exact one-plus-four discovery-block concentration is declared rather than hidden. The quarantine removes no validation date, leaves 122, 122, and 125 complete discovery sessions against a 120-session block floor, leaves 20 and 15 complete sessions in the affected months against a fifteen-session floor, leaves 247 complete 2021 sessions against a 240-session floor, does not increase the original three-session block imbalance, contains no adjacent dates, stays below the exact clock-recurrence thresholds, cannot expand, and must pass six objective SPY/MDY randomization-reference tests. No new exclusion may join a quarantine block, rolling-quarter window, or MDY rolling-year window.

cost_review.issuer_evidence_hash_scope: SHA-256 of each issuer HTTPS response body after HTTP content decoding.
cost_review.mutable_source_warning: Issuer pages and reported spreads change. These hashes preserve the reviewed retrieval identity but are not expected to match later retrievals; reverify before source qualification or strategy authority.
cost_review.disposition: Retain 6 bps per side as a conservative planning assumption, not a historical upper bound. Its adverse component is at least five times the largest current median half-spread, and every qualifying candidate must also pass 12 and 25 bps plus longer delays.
cost_review.limitations: No historical NBBO is acquired. Episodic adverse selection, bar-open uncertainty, latency, impact, queue position, partial fills, and broker-specific costs remain unobserved.
cost_review.future_rule: Evidence that the envelope is too low stops the program; no post-return evidence may lower cost or delay.

preconditions: The licensing and retention gate passes in a reviewed artifact without requiring a paid plan.
Current official documentation still confirms Basic price zero, historical SIP access for end at least fifteen minutes old, and 200 historical requests per minute.
A future isolated adapter passes the complete mock test plan and independent review.

request_contract.start_and_end: Exact inclusive first and last regular-session bar-open timestamps for each frozen chain.

request_ranges.purpose: token pagination and issuer-known split neighborhood

pass_criteria: Every request is an exact frozen GET to data.alpaca.markets with explicit SIP, 5Min, inclusive bounds, adjustment, sort, limit, and asof parameters.
The ten-session December block exceeds 10,000 points per view, returns a non-empty next_page_token, and drains through a null token without duplicate or conflicting coordinates.
Every normal, early-close, distribution, and split control contains each expected coordinate exactly once in both views.
The nine known MDY coordinates may be present or absent. No other coordinate may be absent on a quarantined session, and the five sessions remain excluded either way.
Raw and analytical coordinate sets match exactly after the permitted known-coordinate disposition.
All OHLC values are finite and positive, ranges are valid, and volume is finite and strictly positive.
Raw-versus-analytical price factors are positive and constant within each symbol-session; volume is reciprocal across split factors; every factor change reconciles to the frozen action ledger.
The December 2025 issuer-known 2-for-1 split controls and the June 2024 IWM cash-distribution control match the corporate-action policy.
Repeated parsing of frozen pages produces the same sorted canonical bytes and hashes.
No strategy feature, fill, P&L, return, or candidate gate is calculated.
source_qualification.success_action: Publish one structural receipt only. Do not acquire the remaining chronology, admit a dataset, implement or run a strategy, or observe a return.
source_qualification.failure_action: Consume the one-use authority, retain only evidence permitted by the resolved terms, publish a terminal structural failure receipt, and stop without alternate parameters or providers.

preconditions: A fresh independent review bound the qualification bytes and receipt.
The user granted a separate full exposed acquisition authority.
full_acquisition_design.segmentation: For the 1,509 sessions not covered by qualification, use one exact XNYS session per raw chain and one paired split,spin-off chain. Reuse the twelve singleton qualification ranges and the one retained ten-session pagination range under their original chain identities; do not resegment or request their twenty-two sessions again.
full_acquisition_design.estimated_source_bytes: 0.4-0.8 GiB for paired JSON pages; prospective estimate only
full_acquisition_design.restart_model: Write each response page create-only, fsync it, hash it, then atomically advance the chain checkpoint with the exact next_page_token. On restart, verify every completed page and resume only the recorded token. Never publish duplicate chain identities.
full_acquisition_design.credential_separation: Only the isolated fetch process receives credentials. Dataset admission and research workers receive frozen paths and manifests only.

credential_isolation.logging_rule: Never print, persist, hash, or place credentials in prompts, fixtures, manifests, or exceptions.
